reviewed_scope_reason:
Anchor compact return resources by exact same-side or opposite-reference copper.

These are low-current reference connections, not load-current distribution.
A bounded opposite-reference route may add one actual plated transfer via
inside the original filled resource with complete actual 0.25 mm annulus.
Opposite-layer ground traces may reach actual SOURCE-connected ground copper
without implying a filled reference plane beneath that ground conductor.
Both physical annuli, own numbered
source reachability and original-layer actual fill contact must be proven.
The 0.20 mm width is reserved for physical reference/CMOS ground anchoring;
no motor, field-output, converter, Kelvin or supply-current claim is made.
All actual native net clearance and field projection guards are retained.
No foreign component/outer-copper projection, floating thermal/contact island,
package isolation barrier or raw converter corridor may be crossed. A new
inner track physically contacts its own reference piece and
must reach a genuinely source-anchored same-net piece on the same layer.
Native DRC, flashed layer contacts and all original source clusters decide
acceptance. No same-name or package-internal connection is assumed.
